rationale: No suitable optimization is supported with met prerequisites. The workflow already enables fail-fast (P-LIT-FAIL-FAST) in the matrix and caches the ephy_testing_data dataset. The only directly applicable measured evidence (P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT, experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508) requires representative successful-duration history to set a safe timeout bound, but all five recorded CI runs are failures (39s to 6m41s), so a timeout limit cannot be established without risking false timeouts on valid slow runs, which is the documented contraindication. Applying the evidenced 5-minute timeout would be unsafe because one failure already ran 6m41s and a successful run (full conda setup plus pytest) would likely take longer. Other candidate patterns are ci_service-scoped and require separate policy approval (P-LIT-FAIL-SCHEDULE, P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE, P-LIT-FAILED-JOB-FIRST), are synthetic (P-LIT-FAIL-FAST, P-LIT-FAILED-JOB-FIRST), or are observational/pseudocode with modest benefit and no lockfile in this workflow (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE).
